overview: The Clan Council Chambers is where Vah Shir clan representatives meet to govern Shar Vahl. Ceremonial halls, ancestral banners, and arcane wards define this sacred space.
history: The chambers were established shortly after the founding of Shar Vahl.
Clan leaders met here to form the first civic laws and hunting traditions.
Arcane ward pylons were added to protect the chambers from planar anomalies.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the chambers were expanded and terraced.
The chambers became the site of major clan rites and political decisions.
hooks: A clan dispute escalates into a ceremonial challenge.
An arcane ward destabilizes during a council meeting.
A decree requires immediate coordination with the Royal Palace.
Shadow corruption is detected near the ancestral banners.
